Overview

Gliwice is a city in Silesian with a population of 179,144. A key industrial and technological center in Upper Silesia, home to the Silesian University of Technology and a growing innovation ecosystem. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
